# METADATA.md — Unseen America (test fixture)

Publishing language for this channel. Style and boundaries, never copy.

## Title style

Location-led: the place first, then what the film shows of it. Name the state when verified. Vary the pattern across uploads.

## Description voice

A curious, plain first-person-plural voice. What the place is, what the viewer moves through, when it was filmed if known. No history claims that are not verified.

## Keyword usage

Search language people use for a place, a drive or a walk. Keywords inside sentences.

## Tags

Six to twelve: the place, the state, the format (scenic drive, walk, skyline), the use. No tags for subjects this channel avoids.

## Hashtags

Two to four: the place and the format.

## Call to action

One line inviting the viewer to suggest an overlooked place. Nothing else.

## Location naming

Name the city and state when verified; a district or route only when verified from the footage source. Never guess a place from a look-alike.

## Factual claims

No unverified dates, populations or superlatives. Say that a claim is unverified rather than round it up.
